_about: Plant-confirmed settings for the CCR Kiln-3 advisor. null = keep the current default (see plant_settings.README.md for each key's question number and default). Restart the backend after editing process / bands / state_rules / interlocks / quality; fuels, optimizer and advisor are re-read on every run.

guardrails._about: Hard roof / floor per advisor parameter (CCR operators via project lead 2026-10-21; temp floor 850->820 on 2026-10-23). Checked on the live value and the recommended value (temp: the predicted T+10). A value exactly AT a limit is allowed. null = no limit. Re-read on every request.

combustion._about: GR1: LIVE CO / O2 (2-min average, analyser purge excluded) against the interlock limits; while one is outside, no Accept may add fuel. 'limits' overrides an interlock for GR1 only. Kiln inlet CO 1500 = PLACEHOLDER (2026-10-26) until the CCR confirms the real limit (default 800 is below its normal ~690-1230 ppm).

direction._about: GR2: live temp above the band and the move adds total calciner heat (or below and it cuts heat) by more than min_heat_change_pct -> Accept blocked. Smaller changes are noise / grid rounding.

doc._about: GR3: latest fresh hot meal DOC (sample < 8 h) below min = under-calcining -> the advisor will not cut total calciner heat (clinker quality guard). 94.0 = project lead 2026-10-26 (about the lowest 5 % of live DOC since 1 Jul; plant to confirm).

drift._about: GR6: T+10 forecasts checked by the shadow runner over the last window_min (kiln running, at least min_points checks). Mean abs error above max_mae_c or mean bias beyond max_abs_bias_c -> model drifting, Accept blocked. Test MAE 6.9, persistence 9.1 (2026-10-26); tune once more live checks exist.

process_response._about: Calciner outlet temp change (C) per unit lever change, at 5/10/15/30 min. null = measured default (twin/model.py RESPONSE_DEFAULTS).
